up: Retrieve all molecules reported in the document with ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL5728190'. Return the molecule ChEMBL ID and preferred name for each compound.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, md.pref_name AS preferred_name FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5728190'
